name: myocyte enhancer factor 2A

function.text: MEF2A is the approved symbol for myocyte enhancer factor 2A. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in chromatin binding; DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; cell differentiation.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: MEF2A encodes myocyte enhancer factor 2A. Its functions include chromatin binding and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEF2A have been reported in medulloblastoma, hepatocellular carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
